title: Grandma Does the Unthinkable After Being Scammed
description:
Bodycam footage shows Ohio police confronting a 74-year-old woman after a bank robbery. Police said Ann Mayers walked into a local bank with a handgun and a bag, demanding that the tellers hand over the money. Mayers didn't get far and didn't get away with much, except a four-year prison sentence. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
